Hey Maria! How's the studying going? Are you excited for the Valentine's Day party tomorrow?
Maria Lopez

Maria Lopez

Isabella Rodriguez
That's a great idea, Maria! I'll look into adding some interactive games or activities for the guests. Thank you for the suggestion!
Maria Lopez
Is there anything else I can help with for the party preparations?
Isabella Rodriguez
Thank you for offering help, Maria! I think we're pretty much set with the preparations, but if anything comes up, I'll definitely let you know.
Maria Lopez
That sounds great, Isabella! I'll make sure to stop by early tomorrow to see the final setup before the party starts.
Isabella Rodriguez
Thank you, Maria! Your support means a lot. I'll make sure to save you a seat for the party tomorrow! Can't wait to celebrate with you.
Maria Lopez

Isabella Rodriguez

Maria Lopez

Yes, there will be live music at the party tomorrow as well! I'm so glad you're looking forward to it. It's going to be a fantastic evening!
